title: Add Physics Backpack Stack Sway Wobble & Floating Brick Pickup Number Pops
description: Apply velocity-dependent sinusoidal sway and lean inertia to the backpack brick tower as stack height scales past 15 bricks, and spawn small floating '+1' team-colored pop markers when collecting floor bricks.

title: Add Aerodynamic Dive Wind Streaks, Ground Touchdown Dust Rings & Bouncer Mesh Squash
description: Render fading 3D wind velocity streaks during mid-air dive dashes, spawn expanding ground dust ring decals on landing, and apply vertical mesh squash-and-stretch to mushroom trampolines when stepped on.

title: Add Mid-Air Recovery Roll, Finish Line Confetti Cannons & Dynamic Crowd Cheers
description: Allow player to tap jump while stunned in mid-air to trigger an aerodynamic recovery tumble on touchdown (reducing stun duration by 60%), trigger dual 3D confetti cannons and celebration audio when any runner crosses the qualification arch.

title: Add Dynamic Drift Tire Skidmarks, Water Splash Rings & Ring Collapse Warning Flash
description: Render fading 3D tire skid ribbons during sharp turns at high speed, spawn expanding foam water ripple rings when a kart falls into the sea, and add a pulsing beacon warning when the arena ring begins shrinking.

title: Add Mid-Air Arrow-vs-Arrow Clash Deflection & Floating Headshot Callouts
description: Detect mid-air collisions between player and enemy arrows in duel-manager.ts to trigger a metallic clang, spark burst, and +15 bonus coins, and display floating 'HEADSHOT! 3x' / '+40 HP' callout badges on hits.

title: Eliminate Update-Triggered Array Spread & Vector3 Allocations in BotAI & FactoryManager
description: Replace [...this.bots.filter()] and new THREE.Vector3() in hole-city-io-3d/src/game/systems/bot-ai.ts makeDecision() and new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.7, 0) in conveyor-marble-sort-3d/src/game/systems/factory-manager.ts update(dt) with reusable module scratch instances.

title: Add 3D Canyon Wind Streamer Ribbons & Pinned Hit Arrow Visuals
description: Render drifting 3D wind streamer trails across the canyon whose velocity scales with windX, and visually pin impacting arrows onto enemy archer shields and torsos.

title: Add 3D Tunnel Bus Dispenser, VIP Golden Passengers & Smart Helo Match
description: Add a 3D tunnel arch at the rear of the lot that spawns reserve buses when cleared, spawn VIP Golden Passengers granting 2x coins, and prioritize front-passenger color matching in extractBusWithHelo().

title: Eliminate Hot-Path Vector3 & Quaternion Allocations in Update Loops
description: Replace per-frame new THREE.Vector3 and new THREE.Quaternion allocations inside update(dt) of cannon.ts, projectile.ts, and target-dummy.ts with pre-allocated module-level scratch instances.

title: Eliminate Update Loop Vector3 & Quaternion Allocations in LootCube & ScrewJam
description: Replace per-frame new THREE.Vector3 in voxel-craft-smash-3d/src/game/entities/loot-cube.ts and new THREE.Quaternion in screw-jam-3d/src/main.ts update(dt) with reusable scratch objects.

title: Add Smooth Bay Docking Rotation Alignment & VIP Bay Unlock Glow
description: Smoothly interpolate bus rotation to face forward when docking into loading bays and visually illuminate the VIP Bay wireframe marker upon rewarded ad unlock.

title: Add Jar Shake Inertia Physics & Rainbow Wildcard Sphere
description: Allow tilting or shaking the jar using touch/drag inertia to dislodge trapped smaller spheres, and introduce a rare Rainbow Wildcard sphere every 15 merges that merges with any fruit.

title: Add Conveyor Splitter Gate & Dynamic Speed Surge
description: When combo chains reach 5 matching marbles, accelerate conveyor speed with golden particle trails and activate a lane splitter gate dividing marbles into dual collector tracks.

title: Add Shelf Restock Conveyor Drop & Golden Item Trio Multiplier
description: When a cabinet tier is fully cleared, trigger a soft wooden drawer restock drop from above, and spawn occasional glistening Golden Items that grant 3x Coins when matched.

title: Add Cluster Bomb Cannon Ammo & Slow-Mo Destruct Cam
description: When hitting a tower's foundational support block, trigger a brief 0.3s cinematic slow-mo zoom with trauma shake, and add a cluster bomb ammo type that splits into 3 mini-bombs mid-air.

title: Add Mega-Tornado Hazard & AI Bot Personality Taunts
description: Spawn a roving weather cyclone in the center of the arena during the final 30 seconds that spits swallowed props across the map, and display emoji chat bubbles over bots when they swallow or get swallowed.

title: Add Ricochet Bouncing Projectiles & Golem Frost Freeze
description: Cannonballs bounce up to 2 times off stone fortress walls before detonating, and ice loot cubes freeze advancing golems for 3 seconds.

title: Add Fake-Multiplayer Ghost Drones & Speed Boost Rings
description: Spawn 2-3 AI rival ghost drones with floating player name tags and add golden speed-boost rings between pillars that grant +3 bonus points and brief invulnerability dash.

title: Add Cascade Combo Fever Bar & 2x Score Surge
description: Add a decaying combo fever bar to the top HUD that fills when consecutive 10-tile cascades trigger within 4 seconds; when full, activate Fever Mode with golden particle trails and 2x quota progress.

title: Add Acrylic Plate Raycast Occlusion Feedback & Orbit Hint
description: Include active non-falling plates in tap raycasting so tapping a screw covered by a front plate flashes the obstructing plate in red and displays a subtle 360-orbit hand prompt.

title: Add Translucent Slide Destination Ghost Preview & Gate Pulse
description: When a player grabs a polyomino block, highlight matching color shredder gates with a subtle scale pulse to improve instant visual readability.

title: Add Rapid-Clear Streak Counter & Ascending Audio Pitch
description: Track consecutive valid arrow block clears without a blocked bonk; display a floating streak badge (2x, 3x, 4x...) and ramp Web Audio synth pitch per streak step.
